y1: A man sowed good wheat seed in his field. But at night, his enemy came and sowed weed seeds and went away.
y2: When his servants wanted to pull up the weeds, the owner said, “The wheat might be uprooted too, let them grow together until the harvest.” God will separate them correctly on the last day.
y4: “The kingdom of heaven is like a mustard seed. It is a very small seed, but when it grows, it becomes a big tree where birds build their nests.”
y5: “The kingdom of heaven is like yeast. Even if you mix in a little, all the dough rises.” God's kingdom starts small and grows.
y7: “The kingdom of heaven is like a treasure hidden in a field. The man who finds it is very happy, sells all he has, and buys that field.”
y8: “When a merchant looking for good pearls found a very valuable pearl, he sold all he had and bought it.” Jesus is this valuable.
y10: “The kingdom of heaven is like a net thrown into the sea that gathers all kinds of fish. Fishermen put the good fish into baskets and throw the bad ones away.”
y11: Jesus asked, “Have you understood all these things?” The disciples answered, “Yes!”
verse: “The kingdom of heaven is like a treasure hidden in a field.”
prayer: Jesus, thank You for teaching the secrets of the kingdom of heaven with simple stories. Please make my faith, which is like a small mustard seed, grow too. Let me remember that You are more valuable than any treasure in the world and follow You with joy. I pray in the name of Jesus Christ. Amen.
d0: weed. It is a harmful plant that looks very much like wheat. The enemy sowed weeds in the field.
d1: mustard seed. It is a very, very small seed. When it grows, it becomes taller than a person. The kingdom of heaven is like a mustard seed.
d2: yeast. It is something that makes bread dough rise. Yeast makes all the dough rise.
d3: treasure. It is a very valuable wealth. He found a treasure hidden in a field.
d4: pearl. It is a white and shiny gem formed inside an oyster. The merchant bought a valuable pearl.
d5: net. It is a tool woven from ropes to catch fish. All kinds of fish were gathered in the net.
